caption: The drawing depicts a vertical panel of what appears to be a wooden door or decorative panel. The panel is divided into three sections; the middle section is the largest and contains a detailed relief carving of wheat stalks with leaves, all rendered in varying shades of brown, giving a textured and three-dimensional appearance. The wheat heads are elongated and pointed, with detailed grains and flowing, curved leaves surrounding them. The top and bottom sections are smaller rectangular panels, each with an ornate foliate or acanthus leaf motif in similar brown tones, accentuated with darker and lighter shades for depth. The surrounding frame shows a wood grain pattern, and the background of the image is an off-white color. The lower right corner contains the printed word "WELLINGTON."
title: Wooden Panel
